fact: The Whirlpool Galaxy, the first nebula seen to have a spiral form, about 27 million light-years away.
bio: Charles Messier found it in 1773. In 1845 William Parsons, Earl of Rosse, saw its spiral form through his large telescope in Ireland and sketched it, the first galaxy shown to be a spiral. A smaller companion, NGC 5195, sits at the end of one arm. NASA says its tidal pull has acted for hundreds of millions of years and may trigger star formation.
